home.featureE2eeDesc: Messages are encrypted on your device. Even we can't read them.
home.featureBurnDesc: Destroy all traces of your conversation with one tap.

burnDialog.title: Burn this chat?
burnDialog.description: This will permanently destroy your chat with <1>{{name}}</1>.
burnDialog.warning: All messages and encryption keys will be erased on both devices. This action cannot be undone.

incomingRequest.title: Incoming Chat Request
incomingRequest.subtitle: Someone wants to start a secure conversation with you
incomingRequest.subtitleExpired: This request has expired. It is no longer available.
incomingRequest.securityNote: End-to-end encrypted. Messages cannot be read by anyone else.

errors.ALREADY_ACCEPTED: This request has already been accepted
errors.CONNECTION_ERROR: Connection error. Please check your network
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again
errors.DEFAULT: An error occurred. Please try again

verification.subtitlePending: Compare this fingerprint with your peer to ensure secure connection.
verification.subtitleVerified: Both parties have verified the fingerprint.
verification.subtitleMismatch: Fingerprint mismatch detected. This connection may be compromised.
verification.mismatchWarning: The fingerprints do not match. This could indicate a man-in-the-middle attack. Do not share sensitive information in this chat.
verification.helpText: Ask your peer to read their fingerprint symbols over a voice call or in person. If they match, press "Fingerprint Matches".

userSearch.notFoundHint: Make sure the username is correct or try searching by Telegram ID
userSearch.errorHint: Please try again or check your connection

errors.SELF_SEARCH: You can't start a chat with yourself
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches. Please wait a moment
errors.CONNECTION_ERROR: Connection error. Please check your network

create.title: Create Room
create.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
create.joinModePassword: By password — anyone with the link and password can join
create.joinModeRequest: By request — participants must be approved by the owner

join.title: Join Room
join.subtitle: Enter the room password to continue
join.requestSent: Your request has been sent. Waiting for approval.

chat.noAccessHint: You are not a member of this room

burn.title: Burn this room?
burn.description: This will permanently destroy the room and all its messages.
burn.warning: All messages, encryption keys, and member list will be erased for everyone. This action cannot be undone.

leave.title: Leave room?
leave.description: You will no longer have access to this room's messages.
leave.warning: The room encryption key will be rotated after you leave.
